line.pick: Search an item by code or name
line.typed: Typed by hand — not in the item master
line.onlyList: Pick an item from the list

extras.free: Items may also be typed by hand
extras.freeHint: Off: every line is picked from the item master. On: a line can also be written, but only picked items can move stock.

editor.title: Stock
editor.none: This step does not move stock
editor.hint: Stock moves when the step is marked done. If an approval sends the record back over this step, or the record is cancelled, it is reversed.
editor.firstLines: The first item lines of the record
editor.noLines: No item lines yet — add an “Item lines” field to the start form or a step
editor.short: If there is not enough stock
editor.shortBlock: Stop — the step can't be marked done
editor.shortFlag: Let it pass — short lines wait for the store keeper's approval
editor.needsTo: A transfer needs a place to move to.

preview.title: Stock this step will move
preview.unknown: Not in the item master — will not move
preview.blocked: Not enough stock. This step can't be marked done until stock comes in or the quantity is changed.
preview.flagged: The short lines will wait for the store keeper's approval. The step still goes on.
preview.noted: Short lines will be skipped and noted on the record.
preview.noLines: No item lines to move yet.
preview.needsTo: Say where the stock moves to.
preview.failed: Could not work out the stock for this step.
